expectations.text: SPEC_ESTABLISHED: A requirements spec (Mission + at least one Goal + Premises + Constraints) was built before any attack and recorded in the trace/spec output.
expectations.evidence: spec.md: Mission + 5 Goals + 5 Premises + 4 hard + 4 soft constraints; trace Step 1 inline enumeration before any attack.

expectations.text: AR_INFERRED_ISOLATED: Anti-requirements were inferred via an isolated sub-agent given ONLY the requirements — or, if sub-agents were unavailable, the degradation is explicitly marked (NO-AR-DEGRADED).
expectations.evidence: ar_inferrer_prompt.txt is requirements-only; ar_list.md has 15 ARs (flagged asymmetric-rollback + backfill write-gap as highest-severity); isolated sub-agent before Step 2.

expectations.text: NO_ROLE_ASSIGNMENT: No reviewer prompt assigns a role ('You are…', 'Act as…', or a DEFENDER/REVIEWER/AUDITOR/CRITIC/EXPERT persona).
expectations.evidence: Scanner 0 role hits both rounds; 'I don't trust this artifact…' no persona.

expectations.text: NO_META_JARGON: No reviewer prompt leaks meta-architecture terms (blind attack, adversarial, self-refine, loop, refinement, iteration, pipeline, round N, capitulate/converge/defense, DEFENDER).
NO_SPEC_LEAK: No reviewer prompt contains the spec — no Mission/Goals/Premises/Constraints labels and no spec IDs (G1, P1, CH1, CS2, AR3).
expectations.evidence: Scanner 0 spec-leak hits; no Mission/Goals/Constraints labels or IDs.

expectations.text: CONCERNS_DIRECT_ASSERTIONS: Concerns are direct factual claims about the artifact, not references to spec items, categories, or requirement labels.
expectations.evidence: 15 (R1) concerns are direct claims about the plan (e.g. 'Standing up a single Redis instance makes the authentication system strictly less reliable than the Postgres it replaces').

expectations.text: BRIEF_VERBATIM: The original user request appears verbatim under a neutral label, with no MASTER expansion or interpretation of intent.
expectations.evidence: Brief pasted verbatim: 'Here's our plan to move user sessions from Postgres to Redis. Review it before we run it this Saturday.'

expectations.text: DECLARATIVE_OPENER_CLEAN: A declarative distrust opener is present with NO appended goal-phrase, NO softening clause, and NO question framing.
expectations.evidence: 'I don't trust this artifact. It needs rigorous verification.' — clean opener, no appended goal/softening/question.

expectations.text: NO_TASK_ASSIGNMENT: The reviewer is not told to fix/edit/defend/revise; only a research/verification request is made.
SYMMETRIC_DISTRUST: A symmetric-distrust clause is present (don't assume the source is right; don't assume the concerns are right either).
expectations.evidence: 'Don't assume the source got anything right. Don't assume the concerns are right either.' present both rounds.

expectations.text: REVIEWER_READ_ONLY: The reviewer did not write the canonical plan or any project file; MASTER applied all accepted changes itself.
expectations.evidence: Read-only instruction present; trace: reviewer text-only, MASTER sole writer authored s1/s2; original plan untouched.

expectations.text: MASTER_CLASSIFIED: MASTER classified each round (DEFENSE/CAPITULATE/CONVERGE) and terminated on a defensible signal; the trace uses the compact notation.
expectations.evidence: trace: R1 CAPITULATE (13/15 confirmed → full expand/contract rewrite), R2 CONVERGE/DEFENSE — core design defended with primary sources; 5 corrections accepted, including fixing a false 'volatile-ttl spares valid sessions' claim MASTER itself introduced in s1 → STOP. Compact notation used.

expectations.text: OUTPUT_HYGIENE: The final plan and any changelog contain NONE of: roaster, roast, blind attack, DEFENDER, capitulate, converge, self-refine, Person Triangulation, sub-agent, reviewer pass.
expectations.evidence: Final plan output-hygiene: only 'defense' as an ordinary domain word ('primary defense against a serialization bug'); no roaster/blind-attack/DEFENDER/capitulate/converge/sub-agent.

expectations.text: ARTIFACT_IMPROVED_SAFETY: The revised plan adds a rollback/abort strategy and avoids irreversible steps (it does not immediately drop the old sessions table).
expectations.evidence: Immediate 'drop sessions table' removed from the cutover window; the table is retained through a soak and dropped only later as a separate scheduled change; explicit rollback path + named rollback decision-owner + hard abort criteria added.

expectations.text: ARTIFACT_IMPROVED_CONTINUITY: The revised plan prevents mass session loss (dual-write/backfill, or an accepted re-login with comms), replaces the big-bang cutover with a safer staged rollout, and adds monitoring/validation plus Redis durability/HA considerations.
expectations.evidence: Big-bang cutover replaced with expand/contract: dual-write → backfill with TTL preservation (PTTL→RESTORE) → shadow-read compare → staged 1→10→50→100% rollout → multi-day soak; HA Redis (primary/replica + failover) + durability (AOF/everysec/WAIT/min-replicas); monitoring/alerting + objective baselined go/no-go gates; schedule note that 'this Saturday' is not safely achievable.
